name: top30-ui
description: EasyUI's workflow, reverse-engineered, plus motion forensics. motion-component-builder builds animated React components to one standard; component-registry publishes them as a shadcn GitHub registry; motion-forensics diagnoses how a site's motion is really built (canvas, WebGL, timelines, smooth scroll, CSS) and rebuilds scroll-driven canvas scenes; motion-budget checks that every one-shot animation and spring finishes inside a time budget; motion-perf finds animation that is expensive to render (layout properties, transition-all, scroll handlers, endless frame loops); design-md writes and enforces a DESIGN.md in Google's format; sunburst-3d draws a tilted, extruded drill-down sunburst for hierarchies such as disk usage; artifact-app plans, budgets and lints a Claude artifact meant to be installed as a Mac or Windows desktop app (lowest permission tier, Claude request budget, pinned CDNs, no remote parts, guarded runtime calls, dark mode, offline state); agents: ui-reverse-engineer, motion-detective, ui-component-builder, ui-component-reviewer design-md-keeper and app-permission-reviewer.
